records and tonnage move together inside a category
multiple of its 2001 value, log scale
Where the two dots sit on opposite sides of the centre line, the category filed more rows
for less waste. Other recovery went to twenty-four times the rows on half the tonnage.
Deep-well is the only one that moved the other way on both — fewer rows, and the tonnage
and who the giants are inside each one
share of a category's tonnage in its largest 1% of records
Scale-free, so the cycles are comparable even though the
record counts are not. Wastewater treatment is 100%: its top
1% of rows is all of it. Energy recovery nearly doubled, 37%
to 69%, which is the one real concentration in the file.
All twelve management categories; the eleven with meaningful tonnage are drawn. management_category carries a typo — SLUDGE TRTMNT / STAG / ENCAP on 60
records in 2023 — which is normalised here, because grouping on the raw string files those rows as a category of their own. 2021 publishes no tonnage
and is omitted. Method in the recipe.
